claims.text: The dalteparin boxed warning lists concomitant NSAIDs among factors that can increase the risk of epidural or spinal hematomas in anticoagulated patients.
claims.quote: Factors that can increase the risk of developing epidural or spinal hematomas in these patients include: • Use of indwelling epidural catheters • Concomitant use of other drugs that affect hemostasis, such as non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), platelet inhibitors, other anticoagulants.

headline.text: The dalteparin boxed warning names concomitant NSAIDs as a factor raising spinal hematoma risk (c1).

reported.text: The label names NSAIDs as a class and does not mention diclofenac.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
